items.title: Why Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Is Missing So Many Key Figures
items.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 filing is hundreds of pages long—and it leaves out quite a few financial details. “Anthropic owes investors more information,” one analyst tells WIRED.
items.author: Lauren Goode, Caroline Haskins, Kate Taylor

items.title: The Anthropic S-1 Filing Is Also an AI Doomsday Primer
items.summary: Anthropic thinks “closing the loop” is the best path to AI triumph—and a recipe for “existential” threats to humanity.
items.author: Brian Barrett

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
items.summary: Anthropic on Monday filed documents ahead of a blockbuster IPO that offers insight into the company’s financials, risk factors, and views on the future of AI.
items.author: Joel Khalili, Kate Taylor

items.title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
items.summary: Jayden, Sam, and Zack are eagerly pitching editors on reported stories and investigative features. The catch? They're all AI agents.
items.author: Kate Knibbs

items.title: This AI Radio Host Speaks Spanish and Backs Immigrants. It’s Winning Over Listeners
items.summary: Coyotec is bilingual, swears, and tells listeners how to defend themselves against ICE. Its popularity comes as more broadcasters are experimenting with artificial personalities.
items.author: Jessica Lipsky
